scope: Order totals stated in model free text (no actions) and «cuánto llevo / cuánto vamos» total questions
audit: Real router probe with the agent simulated: action-backed replies, product price questions, chit-chat and unrelated questions where the model states a total, plus total questions phrased with llevo/vamos/voy/van
baselineFindings: Action-backed agent replies were already rebuilt from the cart and price questions were deterministic

Free model text stating a wrong total («Listo, el total es $99.000», «Llevas $10.000 en total», «Jaja, por cierto el total es $99.000») was relayed in the main path and in the off-topic branch, also with an empty cart
«cuanto llevo», «cuánto vamos?» and «y cuánto llevo hasta ahora?» were not cart total questions; the last one asked «¿De cuál producto…?» or relayed the model's total
fix: statedOrderTotals extracts amounts the reply presents as an order total (total/suma/llevas/vamos/va en/queda en/pedido es de + amount). misstatesOrderTotal compares them with the cart subtotal and subtotal + delivery fee; when no action is applied and any stated total disagrees, the main path falls back to the rules (warning agent_misstated_total) and the off-topic branch uses its fallback. isCartChargeQuestion now accepts «(y/entonces/bueno/ok) cuánto llevo/llevamos/vamos/voy/va/van (en total/hasta ahora/por ahora/hasta el momento) (porfa)», which shows the cart.

agent: off (legacy model returns the same text)
contrasts: a correct total from the agent is kept
a product price mention («sale en $6.000») is not a total
«cuánto llevo esperando?», «cuanto se demora», «cuánto vale el domicilio» are not total questions
